title: Blockscene
failed: Could not load the catalog. Close and try again.
insertFailed: Could not create this component. Use the native picker and report its schema.
example: Images are examples; appearance depends on your frontend.
settingsIntro: Gallery thumbnails, wireframe palette and editor preferences. Changes apply the next time the gallery opens; no rebuild is needed.
brokenMedia: The selected media no longer exists; the next source is used.
enabledHelp: Off turns the whole plugin off at once, with no restart: every edit view is native again and the layout group publish check stops. Use it if something goes wrong in production.
toggleHelp: The zone bar shows one button: with both on it expands while any block is collapsed and collapses them all otherwise; with only one on, it offers that action alone.
showRowThumbnails: Show block thumbnails in the rows
states.remember: Remember the last open/close all action
rememberHelp: Only the explicit open all / close all buttons update the memory, per user and browser. Opening one block does not.
previewUrlHelp: Full URL of your frontend page-preview route, e.g. https://site.test/block-preview/page. Leave empty to reuse the origin of Strapi's native Preview (when configured for the content type) with /block-preview/page. The route must implement the bridge (see README).
previewUrlEmpty: No preview URL is set: editors get the Fields + preview and Visual editor modes only on content types where Strapi's native Preview is configured. Elsewhere the mode menu is not shown.
previewModeHelp: Every edit view opens in this mode, unless its content type sets its own below. Editors can switch while they edit; the switch is not remembered.
lazyEditorsHelp: Listed custom fields show a read-only preview until clicked or focused, so opening large pages stays fast. Separate uids with commas.
lazyFieldsInvalid: Use up to {max} custom field uids such as plugin::ckeditor5.CKEditor or global::my-field.
resizeHint: Drag to resize; double-click to reset to half
previewFailed: The preview did not answer within 15 s. If the frontend is still loading it will appear by itself; the form stays usable.
editHelp: Unsaved changes: "Apply" updates the form and the preview; saving and publishing stay in the panel.
editUnsupported: This field has no editor in this dialog; edit it in the form.
blockPreviewInForm: Show preview above fields in form mode
blockPreviewInFormHelp: In form mode an expanded block shows a compact, collapsible read-only preview of its unsaved values above its fields. Side by side and preview modes never show it; the page preview is where editing happens.
zoneFull: The zone already has its maximum number of blocks.
insertMoved: Could not insert at that position; the zone changed.
disabledByServer: BLOCKSCENE_DISABLED is set on the server. The native editor is forced until the server restarts without it.
loadFailed: Could not load settings. Reload to try again.
diagTitle: Block groups need attention; publishing is refused until they are fixed:
diagCloseBeforeOpen: Row {n}: close marker "{uid}" has no open marker before it.
diagMismatch: Row {n}: close marker "{uid}" does not match the open group "{open}" (expected "{expected}").
publishBlocked: Publishing is refused while block groups are unbalanced.
diagSummary: {count, plural, one {# block group problem} other {# block group problems}}; publishing is refused until fixed
diagStrayHint: Remove the stray marker with the row's own delete action, or move it after an open marker.
publishDisabledHint: Publishing is unavailable: save first, fix the errors shown in the form, or check your permissions.
showFieldsHint: Show the field list on each block
contentTypesHelp: The gallery, accordions and page preview work on these content types (the ones with a Dynamic Zone). Turn one off to leave its edit view native. "Opens in" is how every edit view of that type starts; editors can still switch while they edit.
crashed: Blockscene stopped here after an error. The native editor is unaffected. If it happens again, turn Blockscene off in Settings, Blockscene.
starterKitsHelp: Choose a starting structure. Everything is inserted as an unsaved, editable draft.
tagsHelp: Comma separated, up to 10 tags of 24 characters. They become a gallery filter.
sidebarHelp: Buttons on an edge of the visual editor. Each one opens some of the document's own fields in a drawer or a modal.
sidebarInvalid: Give the item a label (up to 40 characters, no < or >) and pick at least one field.
sidebarInvalidSave: Fix the sidebar items marked above before saving.
restoreProjectConfirm: Discard every setting saved on this page and go back to the project defaults from the code?
resetAllConfirm: Discard every setting saved on this page and go back to the defaults?
livePreviewFailed: Live preview unavailable, showing the image.
blockPreviewUrlHelp: Optional. A page of your frontend that renders one block on its own, shown large from a gallery card's magnifying glass, e.g. http://localhost:3026/pt-BR/block-preview/'{name}'/'{variant}'. Placeholders: '{uid}', '{name}' (after the dot), '{category}' (before the dot), '{variant}' (default), '{locale}'. Empty uses the page preview route when there is one, else the image.
confirmDeleteMarker: This is a group marker: only the marker is removed, not the blocks inside the group, and the group stays unbalanced until it is fixed.
copyNothing: Select at least one block to copy.
paste: Paste {count, plural, one {# block} other {# blocks}}
pasted: {count, plural, one {# block pasted} other {# blocks pasted}}.
copied: {count, plural, one {# block copied} other {# blocks copied}}. Paste on any page of this site.
copyFailed: Could not copy: the browser storage is full or blocked.
pasteNotAllowed: Nothing was pasted: "{uid}" is not allowed in this zone.
pasteFull: Nothing was pasted: the zone has no room for {count} more blocks.
pasteUnbalanced: Nothing was pasted: the copied blocks contain an incomplete group.
rowActionFailed: The action could not be completed; the form was not changed.
friendlyLabelsHelp: Fields whose label is still the attribute name read as words ("mobileColumnsCount" becomes "Mobile columns count"). Labels set in "Configure the view" and texts from the project's "fields" config are kept.
hiddenModes.flag: Sent with the flag (the frontend decides)
hiddenBlocksHelp: The eye on each block marks it hidden on the site. Removed: content API reads (REST, GraphQL) leave it out, the admin always shows it. Flag: it is sent with the attribute so the frontend can decide.
hiddenAttributeOff: The plugin config sets hiddenAttribute to false: blocks cannot be hidden.
historyEmpty: No versions yet. Saves, publishes and deletes are recorded from now on.
historyFailed: The history could not be loaded.
historyNotKept: This version is no longer kept.
historyLoaded: Version loaded into the form. Nothing is saved until you save.
historyRemovedFields: No longer in the schema, not loaded: {fields}
historyMissingItems: No longer exist, left out: {media} media files, {relations} related entries, {blocks} blocks
historyLoadFailed: This version could not be loaded.
historySettingsHelp: Records every create, save, publish, unpublish, discard and delete made through Strapi's document service (the admin, the REST and GraphQL APIs, other plugins), with a snapshot of the content. Editors see the versions in the edit view and can load one into the form. This is content activity, not a security audit log: direct database writes are not seen.
historyRetentionHelp: A nightly job empties snapshots older than this or beyond the per-document maximum (the newest are kept) and deletes activity older than its limit. It never deletes media files.
historyInvalid: Whole numbers: 1 to 3650 days (the activity kept at least as long as the snapshots) and 1 to 1000 snapshots.
paneHelp: Checked controls show on the page preview toolbar, in this order. Status and Save/Publish stay together on the right; unchecked controls are hidden.
paneDevicesHelp: Entries of the page width menu, in order; the first one is used until an editor picks another. Custom widths: 240 to 3840 px.
paneInvalid: Keep 1 to 8 widths, none twice; a custom width needs a label (up to 24 characters, no < or >) and a whole number from 240 to 3840.
previewHelp: Unsaved changes appear in the preview. Click a block to open its form, an image to open the Media Library, a text to edit it.
previewNoUrl: No preview URL: set it in Settings, Blockscene, or configure Strapi's native Preview for this content type.
trashDaysHelp: Deleted documents stay in the trash that many days (fixed when each one is deleted), then the nightly job deletes them.
contentSubtitle: Changes made through Strapi (admin, API, plugins) to the content types the version history covers.
contentOff: Version history is off: nothing new is recorded or trashed. Turn it on in Settings, Blockscene.
activityFailed: The activity could not be loaded.
trashFailed: The trash could not be loaded.
trashDeleteConfirm: Delete “{title}” from the trash forever? It cannot be restored afterwards. Media files are not deleted.
trashIncoming: {count} link(s) from other documents or blocks were kept.
restoreChecking: Checking what a restore would do…
restoreIntro: The document comes back as a draft, with its draft content: check it, then publish it again.
restoreNew: A new document is created (Strapi does not reuse the original id).
restoreInto: The locales are added back to the existing document.
restoreBlocked: It cannot be restored as it is (nothing is written):
restoreWarnings: It is restored with these differences:
restoreFailed: The restore failed: nothing was written.
report.typeGone: The content type no longer exists.
report.localeExists: The document has the {locale} locale again.
report.unique: “{value}” is already used in {field} ({locale}) by another document.
report.singleExists: This single type has a document again.
report.nothing: Nothing left to restore: none of its locales is configured any more.
report.published: A published version existed ({locales}): it is kept in the trash entry, the draft is what comes back.
report.localeRemoved: The {locale} locale is no longer configured: skipped.
report.required: Required fields are empty ({locale}): {fields}. Fill them before publishing.
report.fieldsRemoved: Fields the schema no longer has, left out ({locale}): {fields}.
report.media: {count} media file(s) no longer exist, left empty ({locale}).
report.relations: {count} related document(s) no longer exist, left out ({locale}).
report.blocks: {count} block(s) whose component the zone no longer allows, left out ({locale}).
report.incoming: Links from other documents and blocks: {reconnect} put back, {gone} whose owner is gone, {replaced} whose owner points elsewhere now, {published} from published versions (they come back when those documents are published again).
gridColumnsMobile: {count, plural, one {# column} other {# columns}}, {mobile} on mobile
gridCellHint: Open the block. Drag or press Alt with the arrow keys to reorder.
layoutHelp: The group's blocks show as a grid in the form, with the column count this block holds.
layoutNoFields: This block has no field that can hold a column count.
versionsDenied: Ask an administrator to grant the Blockscene Read version history permission.
versionsDisabled: History is not enabled for this content type. Ask an administrator to enable it in Settings > Blockscene (settings.history.enabled).
versionsNew: Save this entry first to start its history.
versionsCountsMissing: Block counts unavailable (older or unrecorded event).
versionsMissing: Some blocks, fields, media or relations are no longer available in this preview.
versionsBridgeLegacy: This preview bridge does not support read-only browsing. Interaction is disabled; update the bridge to support readOnly.
